nodes.label: native DOM analysis charts (T-0029)
chart core: src/ui/charts/core.mjs (pure, DOM-free, no h import)
scaleLinear(domain, range) and nominal px plot box (W, H, pad)
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: maps domain ends to range ends, NaN stays NaN, reversed y works

nodes.label: runs(points): split at non-finite x or y, single points kept as 1-length runs
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: [1,NaN,3,4] gives two runs; no run bridges the gap

nodes.label: ribbon(run, W, H, stroke): continuous polygon in nominal px, emitted as percent clip-path
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: polygon has 2n vertices, all finite, stroke width measured across a horizontal run equals the token

nodes.label: band(run, baselinePct): closed area polygon
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: band of a run closes to the baseline at both ends

nodes.label: polar(angleDeg, radiusPct, cx, cy): 0 deg at top, clockwise, returns percent
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: 0 deg maps to (50, 50-r), 90 deg to (50+r, 50)

nodes.label: resolveChart(spec): spec {box, x, y, series[], rules[], labels[], shapes[]} to mark primitives {ribbons, bands, dots, rules, labels, rects, circles}
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: a 2-series spec resolves to 2 ribbons + dots with percent coords; a series with a gap resolves to 2 ribbons

nodes.label: sourceRows(spec): accessible rows [series, x, y] from the same series data
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs: row count equals finite sample count, missing samples are listed as empty, never 0

nodes.label: renderer: src/ui/charts/render.mjs (imports h, paints only)
renderChart(spec) -> .an-chart root (aspect-ratio box) + mark layer + visually hidden <table>
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs (shim): root has class an-chart, style carries aspect-ratio, children include one table.vh

nodes.label: mark elements: .ch-ribbon/.ch-band (style clip-path), .ch-dot (left/top %), .ch-rule (border, h or v, dashed opt), .ch-label (left/top %, anchor), .ch-rect, .ch-circle
nodes.accept: node test/ui/charts.mjs (shim): each mark type yields an element whose style attribute carries the resolved numbers

nodes.label: styles.css: .an-chart block replaces .an-svg
chart tokens on .an-chart: --chart-stroke 1.5px, --chart-ref 1px, --chart-dot 4px, --chart-ink, --chart-ref-ink
nodes.accept: grep -c 'chart-stroke' src/ui/styles.css >= 2 (declaration + consumer)

nodes.label: series paint as custom properties: .ty-s0..14, .lc-*, .gp-*, .hw-*, .hc-*, .gc-* set --series (+ --dash for mono voices); marks and legend read --series
nodes.accept: grep -c 'stroke:' on the ty-/lc-/gp-/gc-/hw-/hc-/dg- rules in styles.css == 0; .an-leg-mark.ty.sN reads var(--series) or the same colour

nodes.label: .ch-ribbon { mask-image: var(--dash, none) } with -webkit-mask-image, dash = repeating-linear-gradient
nodes.accept: npm run smoke screenshot shows the mono voices and non-kit tiers as dashed; otherwise swap to faint solid (R2 fallback)

nodes.label: forced-colors block: .an-chart marks forced-color-adjust: none

nodes.label: .vh visually-hidden utility (absolute, 1px, clip)
